name: Identify
description: Reveals a magic item's own properties, or what spells are currently affecting a touched creature or object.

mechanics.text: On activation, learn a touched item's properties, how to use them, attunement requirement, and remaining charges (if any); or, touching a creature instead, learn what spells currently affect it. A particular, narrowly-named effect kept as its own Feature rather than folded into feat.detection (which senses presence/direction, not a target's own magical properties).
